description: arXiv:2603.23934v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) are increasingly being applied to multi-view image inputs captured from diverse viewpoints. Despite this growing use, current LVLMs often generate incorrect responses due to visual interference from non-target instances or viewpoints, a phenomenon we term multi-view hallucination (MVH).
